• 10% de descuento reservando online directamente con nosotros a través de la página web, no a través de terceros como PADI. Este es el descuento online estándar y se aplica automáticamente al reservar por la web.
• 10% de descuento para grupos de 5 personas o más, que se suma al 10% de descuento online (20% total reservando online). No aplica automáticamente: el grupo debe contactar al equipo para aplicarlo. Hay que pedirlo al equipo ANTES de pagar: si el grupo paga sin haberlo pedido, pierde el descuento (no se devuelve después). Aplica a buceo recreativo, minicurso y snorkel; no aplica a cursos PADI. • 5% de descuento si traes tu propio equipo COMPLETO (regulador, BCD/chaleco, traje, máscara, aletas, etc.), solo en buceo recreativo y cursos PADI: no aplica al minicurso ni al snorkel, aunque traigas el equipo completo. Tampoco aplica si solo traes parte del equipo.

reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! Welcome — you're going to love the Rosario Islands, it's a beautiful spot for a 2-day dive plan. 🌊

For a 2-day package departing from Cartagena, you have two options:

- *4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives):* 316 USD online / 351 USD regular. 4 daytime dives, lunch on day 1 only.
- *5 Dives – 2 days:* 392 USD online / 436 USD regular. 4 daytime dives + 1 night dive, lunch on day 1 only.

Both require you to be a certified diver and to stay overnight on the islands (hotel not included — you book that directly with the hotel). The boat Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena, dive gear, insurance and the National Park entrance fee are included.

*What to bring:* swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving gear is included in the plan. Also bring your certification card (you can send a photo beforehand or show it on the day).

*Getting to us:* it's easy — the meeting point is Muelle de la Bodeguita, just 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 a.m. There's no hotel pick-up from Cartagena, so each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transport to the dock isn't included). A taxi or a short walk from the old town works fine.

A couple of things to keep in mind: after diving you should wait at least 18 hours before flying, and if it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required.

Would you like me to help you set up the booking? I can send you the link for whichever package fits you best.

You'll also need:
• Complete the form sent in the confirmation email to process the insurance
• Minimum age: 10 and over.
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.

The refresher is booked as *“Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)”*. The online price is *USD 134 per person* (or *COP 475,000* for Colombian clients and residents); the regular price is USD 149 (COP 528,000). Book and pay for the refresher through this link:  
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

https://book.divingplanet.org/book/referral-already-on-the-island/26?language=en#rvrd-1

*Payment:* International clients pay 100% by card on the website. With a foreign card, use your passport as the ID document. The 50% deposit option is only for Colombians and residents of Colombia, including holders of a cédula de extranjería: they can pay 100% online in pesos, or 50% online and the remaining 50% in person by card or cash. The in-person balance is arranged with a team advisor in this chat when closing the booking, not through the website link. Nobody pays 100% at the dock without booking online.

*Accommodation:* The two-day Referral Course requires at least one night on the islands—the night of day 1. There’s no return to Cartagena on day 1, so commuting from Cartagena on both days isn’t an option. Accommodation isn’t included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same applies to multi-day dive packages of 4, 5, 7, or 9 dives: you stay on the islands, and accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel.

Después de la última inmersión debes esperar *al menos 18 horas antes de volar*. El curso termina el segundo día, pero el horario exacto de la última inmersión depende del desarrollo de la actividad.

Si te alojas en otro hotel de las islas, la recogida depende de que tenga acceso marítimo. Para este curso, el día 1 sales desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita en Cartagena; el día 2 te recogen en el hotel entre las 9:30 y las 9:45. El alojamiento no está incluido y se reserva directamente con el hotel. Los cursos de 2 días (Open Water, Curso Referido, Advanced) requieren alojamiento en las islas: al menos una noche, la del día 1 (el día 1 no se vuelve a Cartagena). No hay opción de ir y volver desde Cartagena ambos días. El alojamiento no está incluido y debe reservarse directamente con el hotel. Lo mismo en los paquetes de buceo de varios días (4, 5, 7 y 9 inmersiones): se duerme en las islas y el alojamiento, que no está incluido, se reserva directamente con el hotel.
